# cosmoner_app (Resource)

An app built from a git repository or run from a container image, served on a generated Cosmoner subdomain. **Billed from creation** at its size, to the project's saved card.

`apply` waits until the first deploy is running, up to `timeouts.create` (default 20 minutes). An app whose deploy fails, or is still deploying at the deadline, is kept in state as tainted, so the next apply replaces it; the provider never deletes it on its own, so its logs stay readable. A create the API refuses (a name already in use, a source it cannot deploy, a project that cannot be billed) leaves nothing behind.

The settings and `size` change in place; a size change is invoiced immediately. The source and the app type cannot be changed by the API, so changing them replaces the app.

Environment variables, custom domains and private registry credentials are not managed yet. Needs `apps:read` and `apps:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Built from a repository. `apply` returns once the first deploy is running.
resource "cosmoner_app" "api" {
  name          = "api"
  size          = "shared-s"
  region        = "se-sto"
  git_provider  = "github"
  git_repo      = "acme/api"
  git_branch    = "main"
  auto_deploy   = true
  public_port   = 3000
  build_command = "npm run build"
  run_command   = "npm start"
}

# Run from a public image.
resource "cosmoner_app" "proxy" {
  name               = "proxy"
  size               = "shared-xs"
  region             = "se-sto"
  container_registry = "dockerhub"
  container_image    = "nginx:1.27"
  container_port     = 80

  timeouts {
    create = "10m"
  }
}

output "api_url" {
  value = cosmoner_app.api.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, unique in the project. The subdomain is generated from it at creation.
- `region` (String) Region slug from the app catalogue. The platform decides where the app runs, so this is what was asked for at creation; an imported app reads back where it runs.
- `size` (String) Size slug from the app catalogue, e.g. `shared-s`. Changing it resizes the app in place and invoices the difference. Static sites always run as `shared-static` and cannot be resized.

### Optional

- `app_type` (String) `service` (a long-running process, the default) or `static` (built files served as a site).
- `auto_deploy` (Boolean) Whether a push to `git_branch` deploys the app. Defaults to `false`.
- `build_command` (String) Command that builds the app.
- `build_strategy` (String) How the repository is built, e.g. `nixpacks` or `docker`.
- `container_image` (String) Image to run, e.g. `nginx:1.27`. Set this or `git_repo`.
- `container_port` (Number) Port the image listens on. The API cannot change it, so changing it replaces the app.
- `container_registry` (String) Registry `container_image` is pulled from, e.g. `dockerhub`, `ghcr` or `cosmoner`.
- `git_branch` (String) Branch to build.
- `git_provider` (String) Where `git_repo` lives, e.g. `github`. The project needs that integration connected.
- `git_repo` (String) Repository to build, as `owner/repo`. Set this or `container_image`.
- `image_deploy_policy` (String) What a push to the image's repository does: `TAG`, `NEWEST` or `MANUAL`. The API defaults it to `TAG`. Only meaningful for a project registry image.
- `instances` (Number) How many instances run. The API refuses it for a runtime that runs one, and has no way to unset it, so removing it from configuration keeps the current count.
- `internal_port` (Number) Port for traffic from other apps in the project.
- `output_dir` (String) Directory a static site's build writes to.
- `project_id` (String) Project the resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `public_port` (Number) Port a repository-built app listens on for public traffic.
- `run_command` (String) Command that starts the app.
- `source_dir` (String) Directory in the repository to build from, for monorepos.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the app was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `id` (String) App ID.
- `status` (String) `RUNNING` once deployed; otherwise `DEPLOYING`, `ERROR` or `STOPPED`.
- `subdomain` (String) Generated subdomain the app is served on.
- `url` (String) Public URL, once the app is live.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the first deploy to be running. Defaults to `20m`.
- `delete` (String) How long to wait for the app to be deleted. Defaults to `10m`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<app_id>, or just <app_id> when the provider sets a project.
# `region` is read back as where the app runs; set it to that value afterwards.
terraform import cosmoner_app.api proj_123/clx0app
```
